text:
maria: quick oncall question — I need a short-lived console elevation to pull raw logs for a user-reported PII leak. Is the standard break-glass flow still: 1) post in #incidents, 2) get sec approval, 3) request JIT token?

alex: yep that's the flow. ping sec (julian) + leave justification. how long do you need?

maria: ~30 minutes max, just to grep and copy-matched lines to a redaction bucket. will not export full DB.

sanjay: which host/service? Also please include exact grep so we can scope access.

maria: prod-ingest-01, service=log-collector. I just need to run: ```sudo journalctl -u log-collector -o cat | grep -E 'email|ssn|dob' | head -n 200``` then scp the result to s3://redwood-redact/tmp/1718889999/

alex: ok add that command and S3 path to your incident post. we require the command, duration, and why shared bucket is needed.

maria: noted — posting to #incidents now with ticket INC-1298 and justification.

engsec-bot: Incident INC-1298 created by maria. Auto-tagged: pii, break-glass. Temporary access requires approver: julian.

julian: approved for 30m. please record the exact commands run and upload the raw snippet to the redact bucket. I'll trigger an audit entry after you finish. :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks julian. granting devops the heads-up: @sanjay can you handle the JIT token/role for me? I'll only use it once.

sanjay: will do. creating a one-time role 'tmp-elev-INC-1298' scoped to journalctl + scp, expires in 30m. I'll post the grant command here when done.

sanjay: (grant) `rbac grant --role tmp-elev-INC-1298 --principal maria --expires-in 30m`

maria: role received, testing access now. will paste output excerpt to s3 and then delete local copy.

maria: done — uploaded to s3://redwood-redact/tmp/1718889999/fragment.txt. I redacted emails locally and left context lines only.

julian: noted. schedule looks good. please include the redaction steps in the audit (what fields removed, tool used). I'll close the approval once audit entry is in.

maria: added audit note to INC-1298: replaced emails with [REDACTED_EMAIL], DOBs masked to YYYY, used sed script `/"s/([0-9]{2}/([0-9]{2})/([0-9]{4}))/MASKED/g/` and validated with a quick grep.

engsec-bot: Audit entry created for INC-1298 by julian. Access revoked for tmp-elev-INC-1298 at 1718890299.

maria: closing loop — no further access needed. thanks all. :bow:
